dependencies.scope: The supervisor is specified against the NUN kernel image and handoff contract; neither implementation exists yet.

boundaries: NUNLauncher is a specification-only repository; no bootloader, launcher binary, image writer or installer is implemented.
Image validation must precede handoff and must fail closed on unknown format, version, address range or signature state.
Automatic flashing or boot-chain replacement is prohibited without explicit operator approval and a verified recovery path.
The launcher must not duplicate kernel memory management, scheduling or device-driver responsibilities.

verification.host_tests: Not implemented; specification and manifest validation only.
verification.target_validation: Not implemented; no bootloader, image format implementation or target is declared.
